summary: Cred and Duck discuss the confusing Bitcoin market environment where weekly timeframe signals are being invalidated by headline-driven price action from Trump policy announcements. Both are bullish on Bitcoin primarily due to the corporate strategy FOMO (MicroStrategy copycats globally, especially Japan) which they see as a credit-fueled bubble that hasn't fully played out yet. They warn altcoins may significantly underperform or decline even as BTC rallies. Key invalidation for bulls is a weekly close sub-100k. The dollar weakness is noted as supporting the crypto bid.
key_takeaways: Corporate Bitcoin strategy FOMO is accelerating globally (Japan companies, MicroStrategy copycats) creating bubble conditions
Weekly timeframe TA is unreliable due to Trump headline-driven volatility - need to pick a side and hold
Bulls winning: BTC holding above 100k despite macro chaos is technically impressive
Altcoins likely to underperform significantly during BTC rally - many won't recover
Key bearish invalidation: weekly close below 100k (aggressive) or 90k (conservative)
